children: U.S. data infrastructure firm's fiscal Q1 revenue grew 30%, beating analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS for fiscal Q1 beat analyst expectations
Company raised full-year 2027 revenue and EPS guidance
NetApp sees Q2 net revenues between $2.025 bln and $2.175 bln
Company expects Q2 non-GAAP EPS of $2.54 to $2.64
NetApp raises FY27 net revenue outlook to $7.975 bln-$8.225 bln
ALL-FLASH ARRAY GROWTH - Record all-flash array net revenue rose 47% year-over-year, helping drive overall revenue growth
PUBLIC CLOUD SEGMENT - Public Cloud net revenue grew 28% year-over-year to a record $206 mln
AI AND MULTI-CLOUD DEMAND - CEO said customer adoption for AI and hybrid multi-cloud initiatives contributed to momentum
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "hold" and the breakdown of recommendations is 8 "strong buy" or "buy", 14 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the computer hardware peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for NetApp Inc is $180.00, about 1.7% below its September 1 closing price of $183.16
The stock recently traded at 20 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 20 three months ago
